phase: P0-C native parallel child receipt routing across overlapping batches
failure_mode: An already-reserved parallel native child result was recorded with an owner-wide reservation lookup before the parallel runner could associate it with the batch's exact lease. A later batch that completed first could consume an earlier batch's reservation, causing an erroneous child failure and retained uncertain capacity.
fix: Skip owner-wide session observation for reserved parallel exec_command/shell_command children; retain exact lease attribution in runParallelNativeCommands, while preserving nested write_stdin and ordinary command handling.
